jobs.title: Software Deployment Engineer
jobs.desc: About KPI Solutions KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience â rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971. From initial design through go-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients. Position SummaryÂ The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is an individual-contributor role responsible for the end-to-end delivery, configuration, installation, and support of Kommand warehouse execution/control systems and related material handling hardware (pick-to-light, overhead illuminators, AutoStore, and T-sort integrations). This role owns project-level system configuration, commissioning, installation, upgrade, and live troubleshooting work independently, with minimal oversight, across both on-site and remote/office phases of the project lifecycle. It combines software commissioning, hardware coordination, database scripting, environment configuration, and formal test/sign-off responsibilities that have historically been distributed across multiple roles and a dedicated installation team.Â This position carries broadened scope following the consolidation of hardware installation and commissioning functions previously performed by a dedicated Systems Integration Commissioning (SI C) team, which has since been dissolved. The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is expected to operate as the primary and, in several functions, sole point of ownership for the responsibilities outlined below.Â Key ResponsibilitiesÂ On-Site DeliveryÂ Lead software commissioning of Kommand and peripheral hardware systems at customer sites; serve as primary technical owner, with hardware-side support from junior/peer staff.Â Own full-scope installation of pick-to-light systems, including wiring, physical installation, configuration, and functional testing â a scope absorbed from the former SI C team.Â Own full-scope installation of overhead illuminator systems, following the same end-to-end responsibility as above.Â Conduct IQ (Installation Qualification) and UAT (User Acceptance Testing) following installation, including preparation of formal test documentation and customer sign-off.Â Serve as the sole owner of Kommand and system-level troubleshooting for live, in-production issues during on-site engagements.Â Remote / Office DeliveryÂ Independently deliver new Kommand installations, including application pre-configuration, database scripting, and pre-deployment testing. Sole personnel on this workstream, currently managing 4 upcoming and 1 active installation.Â Independently deliver Kommand version upgrades, including SSDT (SQL Server Data Tools) schema comparisons, version control, local pre-install testing, and direct customer coordination. Sole personnel on this workstream, with approximately 22 major upgrades planned in the current year.Â Production upgrade execution is performed after standard business hours to minimize customer downtime.Â DEV, QA, and Sandbox environment work is performed during standard business hours.Â Validate, diagnose, and remediate reported defects; route confirmed fixes to QA prior to merge and deployment. Escalation to other engineering resources is rare.Â Participate in the on-call rotation covering Kommand, AutoStore, and T-sort system escalations.Â Provide post-go-live project support on an as-needed basis, including system migrations (e.g., bin/location migrations), integration testing with customer ERP/WMS platforms (e.g., SAP/WMS), and multi-site rollout support.Â Project Configuration DeploymentÂ Gather all Kommand configurations and system parameters required for a given project.Â Translate the Business Requirements Document (BRD) and customer conversations into the Kommand system settings spreadsheet, network spreadsheet, and system parameters.Â Educate the client on use of the host interface.Â Not required for all projects â dependent on whether the customer's integration involves interface changes (e.g., AutoCase, Pack Hold).Â Configure the client's Kommand sandbox environment to be project-specific for customer testing, and support the client through that testing.Â Configure the Kommand production environment ahead of go-live.Â Assist with training on any new features requiring customer or internal education.Â Scope IndependenceÂ This role currently operates as the sole owner of several critical workstreams, including all new Kommand installations, all Kommand upgrade delivery, and all live Kommand/system troubleshooting. The role requires the judgment and technical depth to manage customer-facing delivery, testing, and sign-off without a dedicated support team, and to make sound decisions under time pressure during after-hours production changes and live escalations.Â Demonstrated experience commissioning warehouse execution/control software and associated hardware peripherals.Â Working knowledge of SQL Server-based application environments, including SSDT schema comparison and version control practices.Â Experience with formal software testing methodology (IQ/UAT), including documentation and customer sign-off processes.Â Ability to independently diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve live production issues under time pressure.Â Comfort with hands-on installation work (wiring, hardware configuration) for pick-to-light and overhead illumination systems, or willingness/ability to develop this competency.Â Willingness to work after hours and participate in an on-call rotation.Â Ability to translate business requirements documentation and customer conversations into structured system configuration (settings, network, and parameter specifications).Â Strong customer-facing communication skills; comfortable coordinating directly with customer stakeholders during upgrades, go-live support, and system/interface training.Â Preferred QualificationsÂ Prior experience with AutoStore and/or T-sort systems.Â Experience with ERP/WMS integration testing (e.g., SAP).Â Background in material handling, warehouse automation, or industrial controls environments.Â What we Offer: Medical Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Health Care Concierge Service 401(k) Retirement Plan (Pre-tax Roth) Company paid Basic Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability Long-Term Disability Voluntary Life AD D Insurance Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness Hospital Indemnity Insurance Pet Insurance Milk Stork Program Wellness Program with gift card redemption and wellness challenges Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick 10 Holidays) Training Development Why KPI Solutions? At KPI Solutions, youâll be part of a team that values innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. This is more than a reporting roleâitâs an opportunity to make a measurable impact on project success and business performance. KPI Solutions provides equal employment opportunity to all individuals regardless of their race, color, creed, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by states, federal, or local law. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure - Self Managed Experience (SMX)
jobs.desc: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the role: We're hiring for Self-Managed Experience (SMX) — the team responsible for making Camunda 8 deployable in a self-service way for customers who run their own infrastructure. SMX covers two areas of work: installation artifacts (Helm chart, Docker Compose, C8Run) and reference architectures cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure). This role sits primarily on the installation artifacts side — building, maintaining, and releasing the artifacts that ship Camunda 8 to every self-managed customer. You'll be fully embedded in that area day-to-day, but you'll work alongside the reference-architecture side of the team regularly, and SMX is actively working toward enabling every engineer to review and contribute across both stacks over time. SMX is also shifting from a purely artifact- and ops-focused team toward one in which engineers bring customer judgment and product sense alongside technical depth. That means engaging directly with the teams closest to customers — Support, Consulting, Presales — and using that signal to help shape what we prioritize, not just executing a fully-specced ticket. You'll find plenty of room to leave your own footprint: deployment automation, software and infrastructure testing, multi-region setups, and developer experience are all live areas of investment as the team matures from "basic install" toward full-lifecycle ownership (upgrades, backup/restore, disaster recovery). Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale What You’ll Be Doing: Build, maintain, and release C8 distribution artifacts for self-managed customers — Helm Charts (Kubernetes), C8Run, and Docker Compose — along with their documentation. Improve the reliability and usability of deployment artifacts across the full customer lifecycle: installation, upgrades, and day-2 operations, not just initial deployment. Engage directly with internal customer-facing teams (Support, Consulting, Presales) to understand real deployment problems, and use that signal to help shape what gets prioritized — not just how it gets built. Collaborate with Development Teams, Product Management, QA, and Documentation to ship integrated, tested, and documented releases. Take part in the team's shared medic rotation and resolve engineering-level support cases, feeding learnings back into development. Contribute to the shared tooling (review, deployment, and test tooling) that SMX is building so other Camunda teams can adopt it — this is one of the team's current investment areas. What success looks like (first ~3 months): Taken on your first medic rotation slot and support tickets to understand the stack, customer challenges, and deployment environments. Improved onboarding or documentation, turning your own ramp-up experience into concrete improvements. Contributed to artifact fixes, CI/CD enhancements, or test automation that strengthens release quality. Deliver structural improvement initiatives — a feature request, or a test/release improvement. Built working relationships with engineering, QA, and product peers, and started building context on the reference-architecture side of the team. Started forming your own view of a customer pain point from firsthand signal (support tickets, consulting feedback), not just from a ticket description. What You Bring: Ability and/or willingness to use our product, with genuine curiosity about the customer problem behind a ticket — comfortable asking "should we build this" as well as "how do we build this." Strong expertise in building, operating, and maintaining Helm Charts; deploying applications on Kubernetes; implementing CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions; and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform). Ability to create clear technical documentation and communicate effectively across teams. A pragmatic and autonomous approach to programming and problem-solving. You thrive as a manager of one — you build it, you own it — and take pride in delivering maintainable, operable software. Nice-to-haves: Experience running and operating on-prem/self-hosted software on Docker. Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar observability tools. Working knowledge of the Go programming language. Exposure to cloud infrastructure/IaC (Terraform, Crossplane) — useful as SMX moves toward shared review capability across installation artifacts and reference architectures. This role is an existing vacancy #LI-SK1 #LI-Remote #USEAST What We Have to Offer: Compensation We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition. The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills , experience , and location , and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth: United States: $119,900.00 to $193,200.00 United Kingdom: £75,300.00 to £123,800.00 Singapore: S$148,900.00 to S$223,300.00 Canada: C$127,300.00 to C$209,300.00 If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview. Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP) . Benefits Perks We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable. Built working relationships with engineering, QA, and product peers, and started building context on the reference-architecture side of the team. Started forming your own view of a customer pain point from firsthand signal (support tickets, consulting feedback), not just from a ticket description. You thrive as a manager of one — you build it, you own it — and take pride in delivering maintainable, operable software.
